application.title: Thank you for your application
application.intro: We have received your application. You will also get a confirmation by email.
application.whoCalls: {name} will call or message you to get to know you. Keep your phone close by.

items.title: We review your application
items.body: We compare your details with the job.

items.title: We call or message you
items.body: We discuss your experience, your hours and when you can start.

items.title: You start working
items.body: If the job suits you, we agree on your first working day.

registration.title: Thank you for registering
registration.intro: We have received your registration. You will also get a confirmation by email.
registration.whoCalls: {name} will call or message you to hear what work you are looking for.

items.title: We call you
items.body: We discuss what work you are looking for and when you can work.

items.title: We look for suitable work
items.body: We look at which work fits your experience and where you live.

items.title: You start working
items.body: When there is suitable work, we agree on your first working day.

staffRequest.title: Thank you for your request
staffRequest.intro: We have received your request. You will also get a confirmation by email.
staffRequest.whoCalls: {name} will contact you to go through the request.

items.title: We call you
items.body: We discuss the tasks, the working hours and the start date.

items.title: You receive a proposal
items.body: We put forward workers with a clear hourly rate.

items.title: The worker starts
items.body: On the agreed day the worker starts.

contact.title: Thank you for your message
contact.intro: We have received your message. If you entered an email address, you will also get a confirmation by email.
contact.whoCalls: {name} will answer your message. If you asked us to call you back, we will call the number you entered.
